checks.description: Inspect IF-listed feature families in raw telemetry and compare with operator/session notes.
Compare voltage behavior across similar RPM/TPS operating contexts and repeat captures.
Inspect charging/supply measurements and battery terminal/supply-path condition when physically appropriate.
Reproduce the same operating state and compare RPM response against throttle behavior.
Inspect whether the RPM/TPS pattern repeats across independent sessions.
Inspect raw frames, timestamp/frame continuity and checksum/header outcomes.
trigger_evidence: missing or suspect acquisition integrity evidence

checks.description: Check whether the signal changes under a known stimulus before inferring acquisition failure.
Restore required features or inspect preprocessing before causal interpretation.
Review each detector in its own score semantics and phenomenon scope.
Do not treat no detector anomaly evidence as verified healthy without independent validation.
